category_description: How income tax, GST and capital gains tax work in Australia.
subcategory_description: The tax-free threshold, resident tax rates and the Medicare levy.
label: Medicare levy rate
context: A percentage of taxable income, paid in addition to income tax. Some people get a reduction or an exemption, depending on their income and circumstances.

subject_intro: What the Medicare levy is and who pays it, how reductions and exemptions work, and how the levy differs from the separate Medicare levy surcharge.
subject_meta_description: The Medicare levy is {fact:au_medicare_levy_rate} of taxable income, paid on top of income tax. Who pays it, who can get a reduction or exemption and how the surcharge differs.

category_description: How income tax, GST and capital gains tax work in Australia.
subcategory_description: The tax-free threshold, resident tax rates and the Medicare levy.
context: Taxable income up to this amount is not taxed, for someone who is a resident for the full year.

label: Tax rate, first band above the tax-free threshold
context: For an Australian resident for the full year who gets the full tax-free threshold. Applies to income above the threshold, up to the top of this band.

label: Taxable income where the first band ends
context: Taxable income above this amount is taxed at the next rate.

label: Tax rate, second band
context: Applies to taxable income above the top of the first band, up to the top of this band.

label: Taxable income where the second band ends
context: Taxable income above this amount is taxed at the next rate.

label: Tax rate, third band
context: Applies to taxable income above the top of the second band, up to the top of this band.

label: Taxable income where the third band ends
context: Taxable income above this amount is taxed at the top rate.

label: Top tax rate
context: Applies to all taxable income above the top of the third band.
Paid in addition to income tax. The tax rates on this page do not include it.

category_description: Pay, leave and government payments for people who work in Australia.

label: National Minimum Wage per hour
context: Applies to employees who are not covered by an award or enterprise agreement. It starts from the first full pay period on or after 1 July.

label: National Minimum Wage per week (38-hour week)
context: Based on a 38-hour week for a full-time employee.
